query: Create an LSC user story to add two fields to the HCP account: sample eligibility (Eligible/Not Eligible/Needs Review) and the date eligibility was last evaluated, with field-level security for commercial admin, field sales, and compliance read-only permission sets. Priority P1.
expected_behavior: Uses a concrete business persona (e.g. 'Compliance Specialist' or 'Commercial Operations Analyst'), never 'user'/'business user', and does not use 'HCP' as the login persona
Acceptance Criteria use Pattern B (field creation) as structured bullets — NOT forced into Given/When/Then — with API name, object, type, label, track history, required
Includes a Pattern C permission-set/FLS acceptance criterion split into Object level and Field level for each named permission set
Field API names use a consistent LSC_ prefix and are proposed on the standard Account object rather than inventing a new custom object
Includes a '## Technical Implementation (high-level)' section after the ACs
Includes Definition of done checklist and an Estimated Effort table with S/M/L sizing labelled AI-estimated
Raises a Clarification Question about the org's actual permission-set names / prefix if unverified
Proposes saving the story under requirements/<PascalCase>.md
